title: ExecutionRecord
description: Complete record of one execution (possibly several attempts).

extracted.description: Extracted variable names (values are run-local and not persisted here).

Id.description: Stable object identifier. UUIDv7 so ids sort roughly by creation time.

PreparedSummary.description: Summary of the prepared request as it was actually sent (redacted).

inferred.description: Headers Anvil added or inferred, and why.

omitted_secrets.description: Secrets omitted from this summary (labels only).

Protocol.description:
Wire protocol family of a saved request. SOAP and GraphQL are HTTP body
kinds, not separate transports.

EffectiveSettings.description:
Fully-resolved settings used for one execution, with the layer each value
came from (for the Effective Request inspector).

HttpVersionPolicy.description: Protocol negotiation policy for HTTP-family requests.

oneOf.description: ALPN negotiation over TLS (h2, then http/1.1); HTTP/1.1 for cleartext.
HTTP/2 over TLS (ALPN `h2` only — fails rather than silently using HTTP/1.1).
Cleartext HTTP/2 with prior knowledge.
Forced HTTP/3 over QUIC. Never silently sends over TCP.
Try HTTP/3 first, then fall back to TCP; every attempt is recorded.

Timeouts.description:
Separate timeout classes. `None` means "no deadline for this phase" (the
total deadline still applies). Values are milliseconds.

request_write_ms.description: Deadline for handing the complete request (headers + body) to the connection.

response_headers_ms.description: Deadline from request sent to response headers.

body_idle_ms.description: Maximum idle gap between response body chunks.

forward_credentials_cross_origin.description:
Forward `Authorization`/cookies/client identity to a different origin.
Off by default; the target's own configuration applies otherwise.

RetryPolicy.description:
Automatic retry policy. Off by default. Possibly-processed non-idempotent
operations are never retried automatically regardless of this setting.

only_safe.description:
Retained for compatibility. Retries are always limited to failures
proven `not_dispatched` or idempotent methods; a possibly processed
non-idempotent request is never replayed, whatever this says.

oneOf.description: Operating-system resolver (getaddrinfo).
Query the given DNS servers directly (`ip:port`), bypassing the OS resolver.

addresses.description: Addresses to connect to instead of resolving.

max_response_bytes.description:
Hard ceiling on response body bytes read from the wire; exceeded bodies
end with a local `response_too_large` outcome (never a peer fault).

capture_bytes.description:
Bytes retained for display/history; beyond this the body is still read
and counted but marked display-truncated.

FailureKind.description: Typed failure kinds. Rules match on these, never on message text.

oneOf.description:
The auth profile needs an interactive sign-in (OAuth authorization
code + PKCE) before a token exists; the request was not sent.

Peer sent a fatal alert after the client finished its handshake
(TLS 1.3 client-certificate rejection surfaces here).

id.description: Engine-local connection id (stable within one app session).

prior_requests.description: Requests previously served on this connection (0 = fresh).

alpn_offered.description: ALPN protocols offered by the client.

peer_certificates.description: Peer chain as presented (leaf first), when received.

client_certificate_requested.description:
Whether the peer sent a CertificateRequest. `None` = not observed
(handshake did not get that far, or resumed session).

client_certificate_presented.description: The client certificate actually presented (public data only).

oneOf.description:
Verification disabled by an explicit, scoped bypass. Records what strict
verification would have concluded.
Handshake did not reach certificate verification.

PhaseTiming.description:
A measured phase. Offsets are microseconds from attempt start on a
monotonic clock. Concurrent phases may overlap; do not sum them blindly.

oneOf.description: Local validation / preparation (variables, files, profiles, signing).
Waiting for a pooled connection or a concurrency slot.
TCP connect (to the destination, or to the configured proxy).
Proxy tunnel establishment (HTTP CONNECT / SOCKS handshake).
Protocol handshake above TLS (HTTP/2 preface, WebSocket upgrade, ...).
Long-lived session (WebSocket / SSE / TCP / UDP / gRPC stream).
Satisfied by a reused connection; no new measurement exists.
Not part of this attempt (IP literal, cleartext, no body, ...).
Started but outcome unknown (e.g. the attempt was abandoned).

DispatchState.description:
Whether request bytes of an attempt may have reached the peer.

Derived from typed transport state (bytes written to the socket, response
received, HTTP/2 `REFUSED_STREAM`, ...), never from error message text.

oneOf.description:
No request bytes were written (failure before the request was sent), or
the peer explicitly guaranteed non-processing (HTTP/2 REFUSED_STREAM).
The peer received the request (a response to it arrived).
Bytes were written but no response was received; processing may have occurred.

ByteCounts.description:
Byte accounting for one attempt. Logical header sizes on HTTP/2/3 are
estimates (HPACK/QPACK compress headers); `connection_*` counters are
connection-scoped TLS/transport bytes and include other multiplexed streams.

TransportFailure.description:
A typed transport failure with library detail for display. `message` is
sanitized display text only; diagnostic rules must use the typed fields.

tls_alert.description: TLS alert description (e.g. `certificate_required`) when one was received.

h2_error_code.description: HTTP/2 error code (RST_STREAM / GOAWAY) when applicable.

quic_error_code.description: QUIC transport/application error code when applicable.

status.description: HTTP status of a rejected proxy CONNECT / WebSocket handshake.

field.description: Field path for local validation failures (e.g. `headers[2].value`).

deadline_ms.description: The configured deadline that elapsed, for timeouts.

wire_bytes.description: Body bytes received from the wire (after transfer decoding, before content decoding).

display_truncated.description:
True when more bytes were received than retained (display cap only —
NOT a wire failure).

blob_sha256.description: Content-addressed id of the stored raw (captured) bytes.

oneOf.description: Framing completed normally (content-length satisfied, final chunk, END_STREAM).
The stream ended abnormally before framing completed.
The user or a deadline canceled reading.
Reading stopped at the local `max_response_bytes` ceiling.
No body by protocol (HEAD, 204, 304, 1xx).

dropped_messages.description: Messages dropped from the transcript because of the retention bound.

StreamMessage.description: One message/event/datagram in a session transcript (bounded preview).

ExecutionOutcome.description:
The composite outcome. Transport completion, application status and
assertion results are deliberately separate dimensions.

dispatch.description: Summary across all attempts: whether the whole request may have been processed.

TransportState.description: Transport completion, independent of HTTP/RPC status.

oneOf.description: The exchange completed at the transport level (full response framing).
The exchange failed before a response was received.

A response started but did not complete (headers then truncated body,
missing gRPC terminal status, abnormal stream end).

ApplicationState.description:
Application-level result: HTTP status class, gRPC status, SOAP fault,
GraphQL errors. Evaluated only when a response exists.

oneOf.description: Status delivered in HTTP trailers.
Status delivered in response headers (trailers-only response).

gRPC-Web: status delivered in the trailer frame (flag `0x80`) at the
end of the response body.
No terminal status was received — the RPC result is unknown.
Connection ended without a closing handshake (e.g. WebSocket 1006).

DiagnosticFinding.description: A single diagnostic claim with its evidence and confidence.

alternatives.description: Other explanations consistent with the same evidence.

does_not_prove.description: Statements this evidence does NOT establish (shown explicitly).

confirm_with.description: What additional evidence would confirm or refute the claim.

SourceScope.description: Which leg / owner of the path a claim is about.

oneOf.description: Anvil itself, before any network activity.
Anvil ↔ the peer it connected to (gateway or ordinary destination).
The gateway's own admission/configuration/policy decisions.
The gateway ↔ its upstream backend.
Delivery of an already-started response.

Confidence.description:
Qualitative confidence. Anvil never invents probability percentages.
`Unknown` is a correct answer when evidence is insufficient.

EvidenceSource.description:
Where a piece of evidence came from. Rules weight native measurements and
trusted gateway fields above generic status meanings and body heuristics.

oneOf.description: Parsed body structure (SOAP fault, GraphQL errors). Weak evidence of origin.
Ferrum marker from a destination the user explicitly trusts as Ferrum.
Ferrum-like marker from an unverified destination.
Authenticated gateway diagnostic detail (versioned contract).
The person using Anvil (request, credentials, local settings).
